      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "noted inconsistency and failure in bitcoin-tx when using trailing options"

      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "trailing options are not supported across all tools such as bitcoin-tx, causing errors",
      "quote": "I am a bit skeptical though cause probably it will have to be replicated across all the other targets too as opposed to just `bitcoin-cli`. This will mean it should be possible to use this in `bitcoin",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "fixed in push by updating CommandLineRawTx in bitcoin-tx to use GetCommand()",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3767934111"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:5276285103",
      "status_by_quote": "Fixed: `bitcoin-tx` `CommandLineRawTx` now uses `gArgs.GetCommand()` instead of re-scanning raw `argv`"
    },
    {
      "id": "r:4922127763",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "using '--' before a command fails with an invalid parameter error instead of ending option processing",
      "quote": "`--` is only recognized after the command, so using it before the first positional argument (for example, `bitcoin-wallet -help -- create`) incorrectly fails with `Invalid parameter --`.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "fixed in push and confirmed by reviewer ACK",

        "c:5276285103"
      ],

      "status_by_id": "r:4931128049",
      "status_by_quote": "ACK 67a8e5bea2e30c66d7f4eb33e8b124943c5d705f"
    },
    {
      "id": "r:4922192290",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "on Windows, post-command slash options with path values containing slashes are mistaken for positional arguments",
      "quote": "on Windows, a post-command option such as `/datadir=C:/bitcoin` is mistaken for a positional argument because its value contains `/`.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "fixed in push and confirmed by reviewer ACK",
      "author_replies": [

      ],

    },
    {
      "id": "r:4922232564",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "a lone hyphen after a command is rejected as an invalid option instead of being treated as a positional argument",
      "quote": "A lone - after a command, such as in `bitcoin-cli echo -`, is incorrectly treated as an option and rejected with `Invalid parameter -`.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "fixed in push and confirmed by reviewer ACK",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5276285103"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],

      "status_by_id": "r:4931128049",
      "status_by_quote": "ACK 67a8e5bea2e30c66d7f4eb33e8b124943c5d705f"
    },
    {
      "id": "r:4922289743",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "bitcoin-tx rereads raw arguments and misinterprets trailing options like -json as transaction commands",
      "quote": "the parser correctly recognizes a trailing option like `-json`, but `bitcoin-tx` later rereads the original arguments and mistakenly treats `-json` as a transaction-editing command, causing error: `un",

      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "fixed in push and confirmed by reviewer ACK",
